text: ya all of that is trash anyways. and for what its worth if they are being imported from cross app then they arnt anyways so its a dead end, u should remove the code that causes anyone to think that we rely on any cross cart imports because we shouldnt at this point
resolution: Removed the active editor's retired cross-cart catalog bridge. Replaced hmscAssetCatalog with a package-only assetCatalog that loads cart/editor/data/models manifests plus local shader recipes; deleted all legacy snapshot/material/texture/cooked readers and migration merge fallbacks; switched model viewing, thumbnails, authored placement, part reuse, live push, and player push to package mesh documents; added tested per-range package geometry extraction; renamed misleading HMSC catalog/shader/tile symbols and removed cross-cart lineage comments/provenance. Verified 21/21 editor test files, live catalog probe (151 packages, 1643 local assets, zero errors), bundle graph (154 cart inputs, all cart/editor), ReleaseFast ship build, and git diff checks. Preserved unrelated in-flight model/request changes.
